post.summary:
`POST /user/season-claim/redeem` — verifies a season-claim voucher issued
by the testnet side and redeems it (merging the testnet root's XP into
the caller's mainnet account), or dry-runs the entitlement when
`preview` is set. Root-only, same as the issue side.

`POST /user/season-claim/voucher` — issues a short-lived, server-signed
voucher attesting the caller's testnet root address. Root-only: a signed
bearer proof of the wallet's identity is only meaningful for the wallet
that owns it.

AccessActivateRequest.description:
Public Stage 1 activation request (spec §4). The caller is NOT yet
whitelisted. The wallet signs a canonical message that binds the code hash,
its root address, and `signed_at`:
`ekiden-stage1-activate:{sha256(normalized code)}:{root_address}:{signed_at}`
using the same wallet-signature scheme JWT login uses. The root address is
derived from `public_key` (never trusted from the client), exactly as
`/authorize` does.

code.description:
Plaintext access code. Normalized (trim + uppercase) and hashed
server-side; the plaintext is never persisted (S1-D5).

nonce.description:
Replay nonce bound into the Canton activation message. REQUIRED on the
Canton rail, ignored on Aptos.

party_id.description:
Canton party id (`<hint>::<fingerprint>`). REQUIRED on the Canton rail,
ignored on Aptos.

Canton has no address derivable from the public key alone, so the wallet
signs for its party and the server derives the root from that party —
the same identity `/authorize` uses. The party's `::<fingerprint>` suffix
commits to the public key, so a caller cannot claim someone else's party.

public_key.description: Wallet public key, same encoding as `/authorize`'s `public_key`.

signature.description: Wallet signature over the canonical activation message.

signed_at.description:
Unix seconds at which the message was signed. Must be within the
configured signature window of server time.

AccessStatusResponse.description:
`GET /user/access` response (spec §6): the authenticated wallet's Stage-1
standing — whether it activated, its cosmetic badge, and its granted
multiplier (null when never activated).

activated.description: True once this wallet has activated a closed-launch access code.

allocation_reserved.description:
Whether a future airdrop allocation is reserved for this wallet
(season1-conversion §5, S2-D3): true for every activated wallet, false
otherwise. The allocation itself is out of scope; this is the persistence
hook that survives the Stage-1 gate-off.

multiplier_bps.description: Granted activation multiplier in bps; null when never activated.

stage1_badge.description: Cosmetic Stage-1 badge (spec §6); false for un-activated wallets.

available_balance.description: The amount of an asset that can be used to open USDC Perpetual positions (USDC)

equity.description:
Equity under the account without considering the collateral value ratio (calculated in USDC).
Equity = Vault Balance + Perp & Futures Unrealized P&L + Unrealized Funding

margin_balance.description:
Amount that can be used as margin under the account
after considering the collateral value ratio (calculated in USDC)
Total Vault Balance + Perp Unrealized P&L

sub_account_address.description: Sub-Account address (the owner of the technical vault)

total_order_im.description: Pre-occupied margin for order. Locked balance (USDC)

total_position_im.description: Sum of initial margin of all positions.

total_position_mm.description: Sum of maintenance margin for all positions, including estimated close fees.

unrealized_funding.description: Aggregated unrealized funding across all positions (USDC)

realised_pnl_cum.description: Cumulative realized PnL of the closed positions, fees, and funding.

unrealised_pnl.description: Unrealized PnL of the current open positions.

AccountStatisticsOrder.description: Sort direction for account statistics snapshots (older/newer first).

AccountStatisticsStep.description: Temporal resolution for statistics. Single-letter shorthands are allowed(h/d/w/m).

ActivateAccessRequest.description:
`POST /user/access/activate` — redeem a closed-launch code for the
authenticated wallet.

Identity is the session, so the body carries nothing but the code. This
replaces the pre-auth signature ceremony below, which custodial (Auth0)
wallets could never satisfy: they hold no signing key.

code.description:
Plaintext access code. Normalized (trim + uppercase) and hashed
server-side; the plaintext is never persisted (S1-D5).

AffiliateDashboardDownline.description:
Downline user counts at referral levels 1/2/3 below the affiliate (spec §7
`downline`).

AffiliateDashboardResponse.description:
`GET /user/affiliate` response (spec §7). Returned only for an affiliate; a
non-affiliate wallet gets 404.

lifetime_paid_usdt_micro.description:
Lifetime SETTLED commission — the sum of `amount_usdt_micro` over this
affiliate's `paid` weeks, in integer micro-USDT (6dp). Summed at the
database so it is exact regardless of the `weeks` page size. Integer
micro (not the decimal string the sibling money fields use) so the client
can total/compare it without parsing; `0` for an affiliate never paid.

pending_usdt.description: Total computed-but-unpaid commission across all weeks, decimal USDT.

volume.description: Per-level downline volume (decimal USDC). Additive + defaulted.

weeks.description: Weekly commission history, newest week first.

AffiliateDashboardVolume.description:
Lifetime downline trading volume at levels 1/2/3, as decimal USDC strings
(6dp). Strings because the totals can exceed a JS safe integer.

AffiliateDashboardWeek.description: One week of the affiliate's commission history (spec §7 `weeks[]`).

amount_usdt.description: This week's commission for the affiliate, decimal USDT (e.g. `"412.51"`).

paid_at_ms.description:
PAYOUT RECEIPT — when the week was marked `paid`, epoch millis (the
dashboard's ms convention). `null` while still `computed`.

transfer_ref.description:
PAYOUT RECEIPT — the settling transfer's reference (`tb:<id>` on the
TigerBeetle rail). `null` while the week is still `computed`. Additive:
an older client that ignores it is unaffected.

full_message.description:
Optional Aptos Wallet Standard full message (APTOS-prefixed, newline-delimited).
If provided, the backend will verify the signature against this exact string
and also validate that it contains `message: AUTHORIZE|{timestamp_ms}|{nonce}` and a matching `nonce:`.

Example:

APTOS\nmessage: AUTHORIZE|1731541800000|b7d1c2e8f5a94f3db2f8c6a9d1e4\nnonce: b7d1c2e8f5a94f3db2f8c6a9d1e4

id_token.description: Optional Auth0/OIDC `id_token` (RS256) for hosted Canton party auth.

party_id.description: Optional Canton party id (`<hint>::<fingerprint>`) for Console (CIP-103) auth.

public_key.description:
Ed25519 public key as hex (`0x` optional) or standard base64.

Example: 0xa9d81da788977638194c857b918f12ff2233c7a86e82b44705761b2d02426f6d

signature.description:
Ed25519 signature as hex (`0x` optional) or standard base64.
Canton Console: signs `EKIDEN-CANTON-AUTHORIZE|{party_id}|{timestamp_ms}|{nonce}`.

Example: 0xf5ec808e52d014f5193eccf680acf84c6256bdddb0159088e7cb18d74b9c590b92eb4381e10307fccc0868612993dfb9a542257aab22d7a3decfda33045fb905

ClaimQuestResponse.description:
`POST /user/quests/{quest_id}/claim` response (spec §10): the credited
reward. Repeat/inactive/ineligible claims are 400s, not bodies.

active_days.description: Number of days that met the daily-activity threshold.

eligible.description: Whether this entry is eligible to be ranked (min active days met, score > 0).

CompetitionScoringConfig.description:
Parameters that drive score calculation.

- min_daily_activity_units is raw USDC 1e6 units.
- All bps values are basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

consistency_max_bonus_bps.description: Max bonus (bps) granted when a participant hits `consistency_target_days`.

consistency_target_days.description: Target active day count for maximum bonus; required when `use_consistency_multiplier`.

end_weight_bps.description: Weight applied to the last day, in bps. Linear interpolation between start and end.

max_daily_contribution_bps.description: Per-day contribution cap as a fraction (bps) of the positive sum across the window.

min_active_days.description: Required active days for a sub-account to qualify for a rank.

min_daily_activity_units.description: Minimum daily raw metric value (USDC 1e6 units) for a day to count toward `active_days`.

start_weight_bps.description: Weight applied to the first day, in bps (typical: 10000 = 100%).

use_consistency_multiplier.description: Whether to apply the consistency multiplier (scales with active days).

trading_xp.description: XP earned from trading activity: taker/maker fees and position holding.

LeaderboardMeta.description: Pagination metadata for a leaderboard list response.

total.description: Total number of entries in the window.

LeaderboardPlacementResponse.description: Response for the current user's placement(s) on the leaderboard.

data.description: One row per subaccount (or single row when sub_account query is set).

buy_ratio.description: The ratio of the number of long position

sell_ratio.description: The ratio of the number of short position

avg_price.description: Average price at which part (or all) of the order has been executed (i.e. filled)

closed_pnl.description:
Closed profit and loss for each close position order.
Valid only in order WebSocket

cum_exec_fee.description: Cumulative executed trading fee: the total fees charged so far for the executed portion of this order

cum_exec_qty.description:
Cumulative executed quantity: total amount of the order
that has already been filled/executed so far

cum_exec_value.description:
Cumulative executed value: the total value corresponding to the part of
the order that has already been filled. Basically: how much worth in total has been executed so far

expire_time.description: Expiration time for orders with a time-in-force of Good-Til-Date (GTD)

last_price_on_created.description: Last price at the time the order was created

leaves_qty.description: Remaining quantity from the order that has not yet been executed

leaves_value.description:
Estimated value of the remaining quantity (leavesQty)
that remains unfilled. Basically: how much the unfilled portion is “worth”

order_type.description: Order type. Market, Limit. For TP/SL orders, is the order type after the order was triggered

oneOf.description: Stop order type. For example, Stop Market or Stop Limit.
Take Profit / Stop Loss details if set
Conditional order details if this is a conditional order

items.description: Order book level consisting of price and size.

OrderBookLevel.description: Order book level consisting of price and size.

OrderBookSnapshot.description: Order book Snapshot at a specific point in time.

mts.description:
The timestamp from the matching engine when this orderbook data is produced.
It can be correlated with T from public trade channel

ts.description: The timestamp (ms) that the system generates the data

OrderListResponse.description: Response for order list and order history requests.

OrderPriceLimit.description: Order price limits for a given trading symbol.

smp_group.description:
Self-match prevention group id. Orders with the same `(user_id, smp_group)` are eligible
for SMP checks.

oneOf.description: Self-match prevention (SMP/STP) strategy. If unset, SMP is disabled.

Position.description:
Position information.

* risk_id: numeric identifier of the current risk tier your position is on for that symbol.
* risk_limit_value: the maximum position value allowed under that tier (the tier’s limit). If your position value grows beyond this, the tier steps up (higher requirements).

Details:
* Meaning: Bybit enforces “risk limit tiers” to cap position value and scale maintenance margin. The tier is referenced by riskId, and its cap is riskLimitValue.
* Effects: Higher tiers allow larger positions but increase maintenance margin and may constrain leverage.
* Portfolio margin note: In portfolio margin mode, both fields are not meaningful and are returned as 0 (docs: “risk limit rules are invalid”).

created_time.description: Timestamp of the first time a position was created on this symbol (ms)

cum_funding.description: Net realized funding PnL accumulated for this position (receive positive, pay negative).

margin_mode.description: Is position cross margin or isolated margin

position_im_by_mp.description: Initial margin calculated by mark price

position_mm_by_mp.description: Maintenance margin calculated by mark price

realized_pnl_cum.description: Sum of all historical Current Realized PnLs (and the latest one).

realized_pnl_cur.description:
Sum of Fill Realized PnL for position of this symbol/side
since this position was created last time

seq.description:
Cross sequence, used to associate each fill and each position update
* Different symbols may have the same seq, please use seq + symbol to check unique

side.description: Position side. Buy: long, Sell: short

trailing_stop.description: Trailing stop (The distance from market price)

unrealized_funding.description: Net unsettled funding PnL for this position (receive positive, pay negative).

unrealized_pnl.description:
How much USDC an account will receive (or pay if negative)
if the position is closed at the current MarkPrice

PriceKlineSnapshot.description: Price-only kline entry. Used for mark price and index price klines.

PublicTrade.description: A single trade entry from the public trade stream.

T.description: The timestamp (ms) that the order is filled.

RedeemSeasonClaimRequest.description:
`POST /season-claim/redeem` — redeem (or, with `preview`, dry-run) a
season-claim voucher.

binds.description: Number of users who bound through this specific code (`users.bound_via_code_id`).

clicks.description: Number of recorded clicks that resolved to this code (`referral_clicks.code_id`).

downline_count.description:
Total direct downline of this code's owner (`users.referrer_id`). Owner-level, so it is
identical across all of the owner's codes.

ReferralStatus.description: Referral program status for the viewer as a referrer.

l1_bps_effective.description: L1 cut in bps — flat for everyone (ranks removed 2026-07-20).

Closed-tournament eligibility: XP at/above the configured floor
(`gateway.closed_tournament_min_xp`). Ranks removed 2026-07-20.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next ledger page; null when this page is the last.

oneOf.description:
Season-1 starting multiplier (season1-conversion §5); omitted entirely
when the wallet's active-season multiplier is 1.0× (no positive band).

mm_duration.description: The maintenance margin deduction value when risk limit tier changed

SeasonClaimVoucherResponse.description:
`POST /season-claim/voucher` — a signed, time-boxed voucher the mainnet
side redeems to merge a testnet root's XP into the caller's mainnet
account.

SeasonStatus.description:
Season-1 starting-multiplier block for `GET /user/rewards`
(season1-conversion §5). Present only when the wallet's active-season
multiplier is above 1.0× (a positive band); the whole block is omitted at
1.0×.

multiplier_bps.description:
The wallet's Season-1 starting multiplier in bps (always > 0 when the
block is present).

source.description:
The band the wallet's merged Total XP fell into, e.g. `band_2000bps` —
the source of the multiplier.

sl_size.description:
Stop loss size
valid for TP/SL partial mode, note: the value of tpSize and slSize must equal

Take profit size

buy_ratio.description: The ratio of the number of long position

sell_ratio.description: The ratio of the number of short position

Identifies the deployed build for release/version verification without disclosing source code.

low_price_24h.description: The lowest price in the last 24 hours
